semiconductor_relevance: High — Chiyoda Trading supplies specialized materials and components critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Chiyoda Trading offers advanced materials and components for the semiconductor industry, including special ceramics like Aluminum Nitride and Yttria, ultra-thin ball bearings, and innovative coatings such as SilcoTek. Their products are designed to enhance performance in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and meet various testing needs.

Ultra-thin ball bearings for weight reduction and space saving
SilcoTek coatings for corrosion resistance and durability
Bond strength testers for electronic components
